details: Built-up crest cap on each back post: 2 1/2" x 2" cap of three layers (7/8", 3/8", 9/16") projecting 3/16" beyond the 2 1/4" post (detail 8, drawn full size).
Moulded foot on every leg: stepped profile (5/8" and 1/4" steps) with 1" cap over a 3/8" base plate, 3" x 2 1/2" on plan (detail 7, drawn full size).
Thin 1/2" back slat panel between plumb square posts, inclined rearward; 1/2" back cushion hung from small screwed plate hooks (hook detail 11).
Deep 4 5/8" seat rail with a 2" lower rail and 5/8" cross stretchers 9 1/4" above the floor; square 1 1/4" legs; loose leather-over-stuffing seat cushion with 2 1/4" edge blocks.

Full-size Detail Section shows the layered build-up of the crest rail (members 1 1/4", 3/8", 13/16", 3/8", 3/4", 5/8" wide, 3/4" and 1 1/4" high) over a 1/2" panel; note states joinery details omitted except where determined accurately.
